name: Conservation Grant
summary: Annual conservation grants for projects supporting Ohio's native bird species, including habitat management, habitat protection and scientific research. The programme prefers central Ohio projects with outreach components.

amount.note: Up to USD 5,000 for 501(c)(3) nonprofits and educational institutions; up to USD 2,500 for businesses, clubs, other organizations and individuals.

status.quote: Our conservation grant application is available annually and will open again in the fall of 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include 501(c)(3) non-profit organizations, businesses, clubs and organizations not registered as 501(c)(3), educational institutions, and individuals.

geography.quote: The purpose of these grants is to support the conservation of Ohio's native bird species through habitat management efforts, habitat protection (through easements or acquisition) and scientific research.

access.quote: Columbus Audubon accepts a new round of competitive grant applications every fall. Those wishing to apply for a grant need to fill out a grant application.

window.quote: Columbus Audubon accepts a new round of competitive grant applications every fall.

amount.quote: Grant requests can be made for up to $5000 for 501(c)(3)non-profit organizations and educational institutions, and up to $2500 for businesses, clubs and organizations not registered as 501(c)(3), and individuals.
